description: Add a rule. Sets a direction, a target category, and at least one condition. A rule with the same direction and conditions as an existing one is rejected.

counterpartyAddress.description: Match transfers to or from this address

sourceSmartAccountAddress.description: Match transfers on this org account: the sender for outbound, the receiver for inbound

tokenAddress.description: Match transfers of this token. Requires --chain-id.

workspace.description: Workspace alias to run this command in (see `splits auth workspaces`). Overrides SPLITS_WORKSPACE and the active workspace.

name: accounting_rules_create
